card.name: Unit words just before a slash
card.fires_on: The last piece of a measurement unit, such as mL, kg, days or iron, right before the slash of a rate ("/hour", "/min", "per"). It is found in dosing and infusion-rate text.

modes.label: Volume or weight unit
modes.description: The unit letters (L, mL, /kg) in a rate such as mL/hour or mg/kg/day.
modes.example: calculate the infusion rate (m<<L>>/hour) using the patient's weight

modes.label: Time or substance before a slash
modes.description: A count word or substance name that precedes a per-time or per-amount slash or phrase.
modes.example: regular users (3 or more<< days>> per week)

card.writes: It pushes the model to write a slash or "per" next, and away from the article "a".
card.plain: It fires on the unit in a dose rate when a slash like "/hour" or "/min" is about to follow.
